reason: TaskSwarm is a multi-agent orchestration plugin that plans dependency-ordered waves, runs parallel workers in isolated Git worktrees, reviews and merges results, and exposes durable state and a local dashboard.

summaries.zh: TaskSwarm 是一个多智能体任务编排插件，可按依赖关系规划任务波次，在隔离的 Git worktree 中并行执行、评审和合并任务结果。
summaries.en: TaskSwarm is a multi-agent task orchestration plugin that plans dependency-ordered waves and runs, reviews, and merges tasks in parallel isolated Git worktrees.

capabilities: orchestrates multiple AI workers across dependency-ordered task waves
runs parallel workers in isolated Git worktrees
creates commits, branches, and merges worker output
persists task, checkpoint, mailbox, and batch state on disk
provides a local real-time web dashboard and supervisor notifications
